primitives.name: Daemon core
primitives.desc: Shared runtime plumbing for every operator-kit daemon module: configuration, the Substrate chain client (bounded per-call timeout and reconnect, raw reads that never derive a signer), data models, Cardano address decoding, the health server, heartbeat reporting and Discord delivery.

primitives.name: Cert daemon
primitives.desc: Committee attestor: watches receipts, resolves blob locators through the gateway, verifies content (including the self-rooted short-circuit), attests availability certificates on chain and heartbeats.

primitives.name: Checkpoint anchoring
primitives.desc: Batches certified receipts into a Merkle root on a size, age or interval trigger and posts it to the anchor worker; keyed only on the AvailabilityCertified event, so it is source-agnostic.

primitives.name: Evidence submitter
primitives.desc: Lifts pending attestation evidence from the gateway to the tee-attestation pallet.

primitives.name: Slash watcher
primitives.desc: Bad-attestation detection with multisig-aggregated slash and settlement evidence.

primitives.name: Settlement attestors
primitives.desc: Settle-claim and expire-policy attestors that read Cardano state and attest outcomes on chain.

primitives.name: Operator install
primitives.desc: One-command onboarding for validators and attestors: key generation, faucet bootstrap with optional identity capture, daemon install, update and watchdog.

primitives.name: OCI multi-arch index plugin
primitives.desc: Woodpecker plugin (crane + jq), the only image the org GHCR token (gchr_token) is released to. It pushes credential-less kaniko OCI layouts, and publishes one platform as a plain image or several as a verified multi-arch index, moving extra tags only after verification. With the token it runs only on a push or manual pipeline of the default branch, against ghcr.io/flux-point-studios. Publishes operator-kit, materios-gateway, anchor-worker, anchor-worker-materios and saturnswap-backend.

primitives.name: Custody watch
primitives.desc: Read-only watcher that pages Discord on every custody and authority move: root, upgrade, forced-balance, recovery, treasury, finality, timelock and committee-gate calls in finalized Materios blocks (decoded through Sudo, Multisig, Utility and Recovery wrappers with the origin each call dispatches with, so attempts that cannot take effect go to the digest once events, or Sudo.Key and Recovery.Proxy at the block and its parent, prove it), committee and Sudo.Key changes, any change in the recovery of Sudo.Key or an authority (Recoverable, ActiveRecoveries, Proxy, whose friends and rescuers then decode against the reserved budget), runtime environment digests and runtime code hash changes, transactions at watched Cardano custody and contract addresses (a failed script's consumed collateral included), mints and burns under watched policies, and surrender-pool spends checked against the rate-table entitlement, the pinned redeemable asset names and the redeemable supply, with each wallet that gave up legacy units paid exactly its own units' entitlement and no cMATRA paid into the quarantine address. Classification is total and bounded: calls nested as deep as a runtime decodes them are read, each block is decoded within fixed budgets of values (what Sudo.Key, the authorities and their recovery friends and rescuers sign against a budget of its own, then inherents and small extrinsics first) so no block can exhaust its memory or hold back the Cardano sources, no argument value stalls a cursor, and anything unread pages CRITICAL. Cursors, dedupe and delivery state persist in SQLite; pages go out most severe first through a token bucket of ten messages a minute (to its own channel when configured), cheap floods are grouped and many groups merged into one summary, the digest is never starved, a failing or refusing webhook is retried on a doubling delay rather than hammered, and a refused page never holds back the queue. Routine moves and liveness go to a daily digest that names stale sources and says whether the surrender pool covers every unit still redeemable under the merger's redemption pin and rate table (paging below a floor or on a run-out before the deadline), and a source that is unreadable or stays behind its head pages hourly. Replays any recent window without paging.
